sn38.9:1.3: Yaṃ kho āvuso dukkhe aññāṇam dukkhasamudaye aññāṇam dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ ||
sn38.9:1.5: Atthi panāvuso maggo atthi patipadā etissā avijjāya pahānāyāti || ||
sn38.9:1.6: Atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etissā avijjāya pahānāyāti || || 5
sn38.9:1.7: Katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etissā avijjāya pahānāyāti || ||
sn38.9:1.8: Ayam eva kho āvuso ariyo atthaṅgiko maggo etissā avijjāya pahānāya || seyyathīdaṃ ||
sn38.9:1.10: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayam paṭipadā etissā avijjāya pahānāyāti || || 6
sn38.9:1.11: Bhaddhako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etissā avijjāya pahānāya ||
